t2.title: All employees have the right to work from home
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Should all employees have the right to work from home?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
Remote work has become increasingly common since the pandemic. I believe employees should have the option to work from home, though not all jobs allow it.

Firstly, working from home improves work-life balance. Employees save hours on commuting, reducing stress and giving them more time for family and hobbies. This leads to greater job satisfaction and mental wellbeing.

Secondly, many studies show remote workers are often more productive. Without office distractions and unnecessary meetings, employees can focus better on their tasks. Companies also save money on office space and utilities.

However, not all jobs can be done remotely. Healthcare workers, factory employees, and service staff must be physically present. For these roles, flexible scheduling could provide similar benefits.

Furthermore, some employees prefer office environments for social interaction and clear work-home boundaries. A hybrid model offering choice would suit different preferences.

In conclusion, where possible, employees should have the right to choose their work environment. Trust and flexibility benefit both workers and employers.

Dear BloomExpress Team,


Thank you for your email. The flowers were beautiful, and they made my friend very happy. The quality was good. However, the delivery was a bit late, which was a little disappointing.


The website was easy to use, and I had no problems ordering. I think it would be good if you offered some small gifts with the flowers, like a teddy bear or a small box of chocolates. Also, maybe you could have a loyalty program for regular customers.


Overall, I was happy with your service. Thank you.

t2.sampleB2: This is such a hot topic right now, so I thought I'd jump in and share my thoughts. Personally, I think most employees should have the right to work from home, at least some of the time. The biggest plus, in my view, is the boost to work-life balance. Cutting out the daily commute frees up hours that people can spend with their families or simply winding down, which does wonders for morale. On top of that, a lot of us actually get more done at home. Without constant interruptions and back-to-back meetings, it's far easier to knuckle down and focus. That said, let's be realistic – working from home isn't a one-size-fits-all solution. Nurses, factory staff and shop assistants have to be there in person, and some people genuinely miss the buzz of the office. For them, a hybrid setup might strike the right balance. At the end of the day, I reckon the key is trust. If companies give staff the freedom to choose, everyone stands to benefit. What does everyone else think? Do you work from home, and would you ever go back to the office full-time?
t2.uzSample:
Pandemiyadan beri masofaviy ish tobora keng tarqalmoqda. Menimcha, xodimlar uyda ishlash imkoniyatiga ega bo'lishi kerak, garchi barcha ishlar bunga imkon bermasa ham.

Birinchidan, uyda ishlash ish va hayot muvozanatini yaxshilaydi. Xodimlar qatnovga soatlab vaqt tejashadi, bu stressni kamaytiradi va ularga oila va sevimli mashg'ulotlar uchun ko'proq vaqt beradi. Bu ishdan ko'proq qoniqish va ruhiy farovonlikka olib keladi.

Ikkinchidan, ko'plab tadqiqotlar shuni ko'rsatadiki, masofaviy ishchilar ko'pincha unumliroq bo'lishadi. Ofisdagi chalg'ituvchi omillarsiz va keraksiz uchrashuvlarsiz xodimlar o'z vazifalariga yaxshiroq e'tibor qaratishlari mumkin. Kompaniyalar, shuningdek, ofis maydoni va kommunal xizmatlarga pul tejashadi.

Biroq, barcha ishlarni masofadan turib bajarib bo'lmaydi. Sog'liqni saqlash xodimlari, fabrika xodimlari va xizmat ko'rsatuvchi xodimlar jismonan hozir bo'lishlari kerak. Ushbu rollar uchun moslashuvchan jadval shunga o'xshash imtiyozlarni ta'minlashi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, ba'zi xodimlar ijtimoiy aloqa va ish va uy o'rtasida aniq chegaralar uchun ofis muhitini afzal ko'rishadi. Tanlovni taklif qiluvchi gibrid model turli xil afzalliklarga mos keladi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, imkon qadar, xodimlar o'zlarining ish muhitini tanlash huquqiga ega bo'lishlari kerak. Ishonch va moslashuvchanlik ham ishchilar, ham ish beruvchilarga foyda keltiradi.

Biroq, men yetkazib berilganda ba'zi atirgullarning biroz so'liganini payqadim, bu ularning eng yangi holatda bo'lmaganligini ko'rsatadi. Yetkazib berish tez bo'lgani bilan, aniqroq vaqt oralig'idan foyda ko'rishi mumkin edi.


Veb-saytning foydalanuvchi interfeysi intuitiv va buyurtma berish jarayoni soddalashtirilgan. Shunga qaramay, men BloomExpress o'z mahsulot takliflarini gul kompozitsiyalarini to'ldiradigan maxsus sovg'a to'plamlarini o'z ichiga olishi mumkinligiga ishonaman. Ehtimol, mahalliy hunarmand oziq-ovqat ishlab chiqaruvchilari yoki parfyumeriya do'konlari bilan hamkorlik sovg'a qilish tajribasini oshirishi mumkin.


Bundan tashqari, individual xohishlarga moslashtirilgan muntazam gul yetkazib berish uchun obuna xizmatini taklif qilish qimmatli qo'shimcha bo'lishi mumkin. Umid qilamanki, bu takliflar foydali bo'ladi.


Hurmat bilan,


Shohruh Ismoilov

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the flower delivery service. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear BloomExpress Team, Thank you for reaching out about my recent flower order. I was extremely impressed with your service. The bouquet was beautifully arranged and the flowers were fresher than expected. The delivery arrived exactly on time, which was crucial as it was a birthday surprise. Your website was very easy to navigate. However, I have some suggestions. The gift card message options were limited. I would appreciate the ability to write personalized messages of any length. Additionally, the packaging was standard and didn't feel particularly special for a premium bouquet. For future offerings, I would love to see subscription plans for regular flower deliveries and options to add chocolates or gifts. Same-day delivery would also be helpful for last-minute occasions. Overall, I am very satisfied and will order again. Yours sincerely, Shohruh Ismoilov

Hi BloomExpress!

Delivery okay.
Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Hello BloomExpress,

Thank you for the flowers. They were nice and my mum liked them. The delivery was on time, and that was good because it was her birthday. But the website was a little bit difficult to use. I think you should have more pictures. And maybe sell cards too. Thank you.

Bye,

Shohruh Ismoilov
t12.sampleB1:
Dear BloomExpress Team,

Thank you for your email. I wanted to say that I was happy with the flowers I ordered. They were very pretty and looked just like the picture on your website. The delivery was also good; it arrived when it was supposed to.

However, I think your website could be better. It was a little bit slow, and it was hard to find the right flowers. Also, I think you should sell other things, like chocolates or teddy bears, with the flowers. That would be a good idea.

Overall, I was satisfied, and I would probably order from you again.

Sincerely,
Shohruh Ismoilov
t12.sampleB2: Dear BloomExpress Team, Thank you for getting in touch about my recent order. On the whole, I was delighted with your service. The bouquet was beautifully arranged, and the flowers stayed fresh for well over a week. Delivery was prompt and, crucially, arrived exactly when promised, which mattered as it was for a special occasion. I also found your website straightforward to navigate, and the whole ordering process took just a couple of minutes. That said, I do have a few suggestions. It would be wonderful if you could introduce a subscription service for regular deliveries, along with the option to add chocolates or a greeting card. A same-day delivery slot would also come in handy for last-minute orders. All in all, I was very satisfied and will certainly order from you again. Yours sincerely, Bekzod Aliyev

Hurmatli BloomExpress jamoasi,

Yaqinda bergan gullar buyurtmam bo'yicha murojaat qilganingiz uchun rahmat.

Sizning xizmatingizdan juda ta'sirlandim. Guldasta juda chiroyli tarzda tuzilgan va gullar kutilganidan ham yangiroq edi. Yetkazib berish aynan vaqtida keldi, bu esa tug'ilgan kun sovg'asi bo'lgani uchun juda muhim edi. Veb-saytingizda navigatsiya juda oson edi.

Biroq, menda ba'zi takliflar bor. Sovg'a kartochkasidagi xabar variantlari cheklangan edi. Men har qanday uzunlikdagi shaxsiy xabarlarni yozish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lishni xohlardim. Bundan tashqari, qadoqlash standart edi va premium guldasta uchun unchalik maxsus emasdek tuyuldi.

Kelajakdagi takliflar uchun, men muntazam ravishda gullar yetkazib berish uchun obuna rejalari va shokolad yoki sovg'alar qo'shish imkoniyatlarini ko'rishni xohlardim. Xuddi shu kuni yetkazib berish ham so'nggi daqiqalardagi holatlar uchun foydali bo'lar edi.

Umuman olganda, men juda mamnunman va yana buyurtma beraman.

Hurmat bilan,

Shohruh Ismoilov

Biroq, menimcha, veb-saytingiz yaxshiroq bo'lishi mumkin. U biroz sekin edi va to'g'ri gullarni topish qiyin edi. Shuningdek, menimcha, siz gullar bilan birga boshqa narsalarni, masalan, shokoladlar yoki ayiqchalar sotishingiz kerak. Bu yaxshi fikr bo'lardi.

Hurmatli BloomExpress jamoasi,

Yaqinda bergan buyurtmam bo'yicha javob xatingiz uchun rahmat. Tajribam haqida fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirish uchun yozyapman.

Umuman olganda, guldastaning sifatidan mamnun bo'ldim. Gullar yangi edi va kompozitsiyasi chiroyli edi. Yetkazib berish ham tez va samarali bo'ldi, bu meni xursand qildi. Veb-saytingizda navigatsiya qilish nisbatan oson edi.

Biroq, takomillashtirish uchun bir nechta takliflarim bor. Birinchidan, mavjud guldastalar assortimenti biroz cheklangan deb his qildim. Tanlovingizni kengaytirish, ehtimol, mavsumiy variantlar bilan, foydali bo'lardi. Ikkinchidan, o'ylaymanki, aniqroq yetkazib berish vaqti kabi turli xil yetkazib berish variantlarini taklif qilish mijozlarning qoniqishini oshirishi mumkin. Gullar bilan birga sotib olish uchun vaza tanlovini ham kengaytirsangiz juda yaxshi bo'lardi.

Umuman olganda, ijobiy tajribaga ega bo'ldim va sizning xizmatingizdan yana foydalanishni o'ylab ko'raman. Umid qilamanki, bu fikr-mulohazalar foydali bo'ladi.

Hurmat bilan,
Shohruh Ismoilov
